segments.name: Human pharmaceutical products
segments.evidence: We discover, develop, manufacture, and market products in a single business segment—human pharmaceutical products.

revenueModel.text: Lilly earns net product revenue from selling medicines to wholesalers and other customers, plus collaboration revenue from profit-sharing, royalties, and upfront and milestone payments.
revenueModel.evidence: We recognize revenue primarily from two different types of contracts, product sales to customers (net product revenue) and collaborations and other arrangements.
